principles: Proof-or-stop: closeout is usable only if the canonical root can read it after DONE cleanup.
Do not weaken missing-ledger behavior; no fabricated success snapshots.
Keep live status and historical closeout separated.
Regression tests must fail when the only copy is worktree-local.
drivers: B-bfba real DONE left milestone_closeout missing from canonical main.
DONE cleanup deletes the story worktree, so worktree-local evidence is insufficient.
Future hosts need stable post-DONE progress proof without stale live milestone_status confusion.

options.name: Commit closeout through DONE effects and assert canonical root
pros: Targets the actual failure boundary: merge/cleanup durability
Keeps milestone_status live and milestone_closeout historical
cons: Requires touching high-risk DONE merge code

options.name: Only extend helper/unit tests
cons: Would repeat the B-bfba miss: worktree-local write can pass while canonical root still misses
Does not prove user-visible DONE behavior

options.name: Recompute closeout lazily on milestone_closeout read
cons: Would turn historical closeout into a recomputed live view
Can fabricate or drift from accepted DONE state

chosen: Commit closeout through DONE effects and assert canonical root
rationale: The failure is at the durable DONE boundary, so the fix must persist or hand off milestone-closeout.json through the same path that commits story metadata and merges to main, then prove it from the canonical root after cleanup.

preMortem.trigger: Test asserts only store.writeMilestoneCloseout before cleanup
preMortem.consequence: DONE users still see Snapshot: missing
preMortem.mitigation: Add canonical-root post-DONE assertion after cleanup/merge

preMortem.mitigation: Keep mutation inside existing DONE effects ordering and verify clean worktree plus full validate
